jobs.title: Assistant Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**  
We're a growing general contractor with about 5 active jobs. This role works directly with the owner and touches every part of the business — project documents, subcontractor compliance, permits, scheduling, client communication, and whatever else comes up that day. It's a practical, hands-on position with real responsibility and room to grow, and no two days look the same.

This starts as a part-time role with a clear path to full-time as the company grows. We're looking for someone who wants to build something here, not just fill hours.

**Schedule & Availability**  
We need someone comfortable with a flexible schedule. Construction is unpredictable, and sometimes things come up after hours or on weekends. We don't expect you to be on call 24/7, but we need someone who picks up when it matters.

**Bilingual Required**  
Spanish/English — you'll communicate with subs, vendors, and crew members in both languages.

**Responsibilities**

* Manage project documents and filing — contracts, drawings, change orders, permits, and inspection schedules
* Handle phones, email, and day-to-day questions from vendors and clients
* Track subcontractor COIs, W-9s, and vendor insurance files; flag anything expiring
* Prepare, distribute, and log change orders; confirm owner sign-off before work proceeds
* Run local errands and track punch list items and final inspections through to completion
* Solicit bids from subcontractors, track responses, and organize incoming proposals
* Assemble closeout documents — warranties, as-builts, O&M manuals — and collect final lien waivers
* Enter data into QuickBooks
* Help organize and improve our file structures and tracking systems

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with construction software (Procore, Buildertrend, CoConstruct) or QuickBooks
* Familiarity with prevailing wage portals

Pay: $25.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 25.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Pasadena, CA 91105

jobs.title: Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Community Clinic Association of Los Angeles County (CCALAC) is a non-profit membership organization that provides a wide variety of essential services to community health centers that serve the Los Angeles region. Founded in 1994, CCALAC’s mission is to “empower health centers to remain at the forefront of health care transformation. We forge partnerships, foster innovation, promote health equity, and advocate for the communities they serve.”

CCALAC represents 68 community health center organizations that provide comprehensive primary, dental and behavioral health services throughout Los Angeles County. Health centers in Los Angeles serve 2.18 million patients annually regardless of ability to pay. These organizations include private, non-profit, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), and community health centers.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Reporting to the Communications Manager, the Communications Coordinator is responsible for activities that support CCALAC’s communications strategy. This includes media relations, internal and external communications development, event promotion and digital media. The Communications Coordinator is responsible for developing and implementing media and social media strategies to advance the mission and vision of CCALAC members and further the advocacy and public relations goals of the organization.

**JOB DUTIES**

**COMMUNICATIONS**

* Support the Communications Manager with CCALAC’s communications strategy.
* Collaborate with the Communications Manager to develop materials for public relations (e.g., press releases, statements, op-ed articles, etc.).
* Develop and maintain media lists.
* Contribute ideas to, draft copy for, and design member newsletter.
* Coordinate networking and best practice sharing among member communications and marketing leads in collaboration with Communications Manager.

**BRANDING AND DESIGN**

* Support the organization’s external image and branding by ensuring adherence of all CCALAC communication materials to the organization’s style guide. This includes maintaining the style guide, and supporting CCALAC divisions and individuals with development and edits of internal and external communication materials.
* Create graphics, flyers, PowerPoints and branded items using tools like Canva or Google Slides.

**DIGITAL MEDIA**

* Create original social media content (photos, graphics and video) to highlight CCALAC and member achievements, events and critical issues impacting health centers and their patients.
* Monitor social media accounts (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn) and respond to comments and inquiries.
* Collaborate with Communications Manager to engage key audiences and partners and to foster relationships online.
* Organize digital media library and develop a catalogue system for content.
* Periodically visit member clinics and attend member events across Los Angeles to take photos and videos.
* Create analytics reports.
* Identify emerging social media trends and make recommendations on if/how CCALAC should incorporate them into the organization’s strategy.
* Assist with writing and updating website content.

**EVENTS**

* Design, create and edit invitations, flyers, posters and other print and electronic materials.
* Promote events via marketing emails, social media, targeted outreach and other methods.
* Photograph and record events as needed.
* Assist in the promotion and coordination of activities for the annual National Health Center Week.

**OTHER PROJECTS**

Assist the Senior Director of Government and External Affairs and CCALAC leadership with other duties as assigned to advance the organization’s mission and vision.

**MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS**

1. Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communication, or digital media related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

2. A minimum of three years of related communications experience.

3. Ability to maintain confidential information.

4. Knowledge of or familiarity with health care, health policy issues, and/or Los Angeles County health care system preferred.

5. Ability to work as part of a team as well as independently with minimal supervision.

6. Strong reading comprehension, oral, and written skills required.

7. Strong skills with Excel & MS Office Suite required.

8. Ability to draft content that is succinct, grammatically correct and error free.

9. Experience presenting information in written, graphic, and verbal formats.

10. Experience with social media, branding, marketing, and communications strategy.

11. Experience creating materials including simple promotional flyers, infographics, digital graphics, presentations, memos, issue briefs, and reports.

12. Familiarity with software for document and materials creation (e.g., PowerPoint, Adobe CC, Canva, Google Slides, etc.), and making simple photo edits (e.g., cropping, brightening).

13. Experience/familiarity with email marketing platforms.

14. Follow directions and respond positively to constructive feedback.

15. Manage time effectively and pay excellent attention to detail.

16. Comfortable advocating for or against policies that affect community health centers.

17. Flexibility to adapt as priorities shift/change.

18. Develop and maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, organization leadership and external partners.

19. Strong sense of accountability to community.

**LOCATION:** Candidates must reside in one of the following Southern California counties: Los Angeles, Ventura, Santa Barbara, Kern, San Luis Obispo, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego and Imperial.

**About Million Dollar Baby Co.**

Million Dollar Baby Co. started in 1990 and is proudly family-owned and operated in Los Angeles. Since then, MDB has grown to 7 distinct brands of children's furnishings ranging in style, aesthetic, and price, while carrying some of the industry's most eco-conscious and award-winning designs. We can be found in retailers like Target and Amazon, and specialty retailers like Pottery Barn Kids and Crate & Barrel.
  
  
Under the Million Dollar Baby Co. parent company are our family of brands: **Babyletto, daVinci, Nursery Works, and Namesake.** We're proud to offer the most **Greenguard Gold–certified** cribs on the market and to use **FSC-certified** sustainable wood across our brands whenever possible. We've also pioneered Styrofoam-free packaging for several of our best-selling collections — an innovation that reduces waste while protecting our products during shipment.  
  
At Million Dollar Baby Co., our team members are our #1 priority, and we partner with exceptional partners and retailers around the world who share our core values:  
  

* **Treat Your Team Like Family** — lead with respect, gratitude, empathy, and kindness.
* **Make an Impact, Drive Results** — focus on meaningful work that moves families forward.
* **Deliver a "Wow" Customer Experience Every Time** — every detail matters.
* **Strive for Continuous Improvement & Learning** — keep growing, keep getting better.
* **Cultivate Quality Conversations** — communicate honestly and thoughtfully to build trust.

  
Over the years, our commitment to people, innovation, and a positive workplace culture has earned us five consecutive **"Best Place to Work"** awards, one of the best workplaces by **"Built in LA"**, a 4.6 rating on **Glassdoor**, and 13 years on the **Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies** list — recognitions that reflect the heart of who we are and the community we're proud to build. * Manage the full lifecycle of each partnership: outreach, contracting, product send-outs, content review, and payment coordination

* Review all submitted content against brief and brand standards before it goes live

* Own and organize the UGC asset library — archiving, tagging, and surfacing evergreen content for repurposing

  

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead the growth marketing content grid and recommend high-performing UGC for ad creative

* Represent the partnerships function in Growth Content Alignment Meetings

**Best-Seller & Always-On Content**

* Proactively surface seasonal best-seller opportunities to the broader marketing team

**Press Support**

* Own incoming press request management across Babyletto, Namesake, and DaVinci

* Maintain and oversee the press tracker via Google Analytics

* Serve as the point of contact between the marketing team and PR agency — providing product information, brand context, and timely support

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* An excellent written and verbal communicator who can shift tone between a creator DM, an internal brief, and a press response without missing a beat

* Detail-obsessed when it comes to contracts, timelines, and deliverables — nothing slips through the cracks

* You have a trained eye for brand fit: you can look at a creator's feed and immediately sense whether they align with Babyletto's elevated, design-forward aesthetic or Namesake's heritage warmth

* Comfortable negotiating — you can advocate for the brand's budget while keeping the relationship healthy

* Proactive and solutions-oriented: you flag issues early and come with a plan, not just a problem

* Genuinely interested in the creator and influencer space — you follow trends, know the platforms, and understand what makes content perform

**About Cinelease**

Since 1977, Cinelease has supported the film and television industry with lighting and grip equipment, production services, and studio facilities. Our reputation is built on exceptional service, industry expertise, and a commitment to helping productions succeed.

We are looking for a creative, organized Marketing & Social Media Manager to bring the Cinelease story to life through compelling content, thoughtful design, and engaging digital campaigns.

**About the Role**

The Marketing & Social Media Manager will manage Cinelease’s social media presence, develop campaign concepts, and create marketing assets that strengthen

brand awareness and customer engagement across our divisions. Working closely with marketing leadership, project directors, and internal teams, you will

translate business priorities into clear messaging and effective creative work. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys both developing ideas and bringing them to life.

An initial priority will be evaluating Cinelease’s social media channels and implementing a coordinated plan to improve content quality, brand consistency, and audience engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Social Media Management**

* Own the social content calendar and day-to-day publishing, aligning content with company initiatives, services, events, and relevant industry conversations.
* Write and publish content tailored to each platform, manage community engagement, and connect customer inquiries with the appropriate teams.
* Monitor channel performance, audience insights, and emerging trends to recommend improvements and report on reach, engagement, website traffic, and

relevant inquiries.

**Creative Content & Campaign Management**

* Develop campaign concepts and stories that showcase Cinelease’s people, equipment, facilities, and services while supporting the broader brand strategy.
* Capture and edit photography and video, and create graphics for digital campaigns, sales materials, merchandise, and internal communications.
* Manage assigned creative projects from concept through publication, collaborating with internal teams and outside partners to coordinate priorities,

timelines, feedback, and approvals.

* Maintain consistent messaging and design across divisions and channels, including creative support for website updates and customer-facing digital

initiatives.

* At least three years of relevant experience in marketing, social media management, creative content production, or a related field.

* Familiarity with film and television production, equipment rental, studio operations, or related business-to-business services.

* Motion graphics, basic animation, paid social campaign support, or website content management experience.
* A degree in marketing, communications, graphic design, film, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success means a consistent, engaging social media presence; creative work that clearly communicates Cinelease’s capabilities; reliable campaign delivery; and measurable improvements in audience engagement and relevant customer interest. This role offers the opportunity to shape how Cinelease’s people, expertise, and services are represented across its marketing channels. You will collaborate with teams supporting film and television production and see your ideas become content used throughout the business.

* Manage campaign intake, timelines, approvals, audience lists, quality assurance, and deployment checklists to help ensure accurate and on-time execution
* Build, maintain, and optimize automated customer journeys and behavior-triggered campaigns, including timely follow-up communications based on eligible website activity, product-page engagement, form submissions, and other defined signals
* Coordinate lead capture, routing, tracking, and handoff processes in partnership with Marketing and business teams
* Monitor data quality, consent, preferences, and audience segmentation practices in accordance with privacy, compliance, and governance requirements
* Build and maintain campaign reports, dashboards, and recurring performance updates; identify trends and opportunities for improvement
* Document workflows, standard operating procedures, platform configurations, and training materials
* Troubleshoot platform and campaign issues, coordinate resolution with internal partners and vendors, and communicate status clearly to stakeholders
* Support testing, implementation, and adoption of new marketing technology, integrations, and process improvements

Qualifications:

* 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, campaign operations, CRM, digital marketing, or a related field
* Hands-on experience with marketing automation or customer engagement platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights -Journeys, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or similar tools
* Experience building and supporting automated customer journeys, behavior-triggered email campaigns, audience segmentation, lead management, testing, and performance reporting
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple requests, deadlines, dependencies, and stakeholders
* Working knowledge of CRM data, data hygiene, consent management, and digital marketing compliance practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights and recommended actions
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools such as Excel, SharePoint, and Copilot
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Organized, detail-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively across technical and nontechnical teams
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment while balancing operational accuracy with continuous improvement

A plus if you have:

* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Power Bl, Power Automate, or related marketing technology
* Experience with system integrations, user acceptance testing, or platform implementations
* Banking, financial services, or another regulated industry experience
* Familiarity with event marketing, webinar platforms, web analytics, or digital asset management
* Relevant platform certifications

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is USD $73,000.00/Yr. - USD $85,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

jobs.description:
Conard House, Inc. is a non-profit organization that focuses on empowering people and restoring hope for our community members and workforce. We work with a diverse adult population and strive for cultural competency by respecting experience, promoting inclusion and building community. The position is with the SF Connected program, which provides various services including: computer training, resume building, tablet training, social media training, and other services that improve the quality of life/independence of older adults and adults with disabilities in San Francisco. * Develop curriculum for classes that is suitable for Conard House consumers that will include usage of computers and commonly used software and apps.
* Train and assist consumers on assistive technologies and accessibility features to promote independence and enhance consumers’ daily living.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - GI Division
jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will join the GI Division and responsibilities will include coordination of clinical research studies related liver disease and liver transplantation. The Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies. The CRC will work on the DeLIVER Care, provides HCV screening and low-threshold standard of care HCV treatment on at various locations in San Francisco on a mobile van.

CRC’s duties may include, management and coordinating the tasks of multiple clinical research studies, act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, assist with training of Assistant CRCs, and assist PI supervisor with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.

The CRC will also be responsible for performing fingersticks for rapid HCV antibody testing and/or HCV RNA, venipuncture for HCV RNA confirmatory testing and other labs, driving the van, and completing research activities such as consenting participants, extracting information from medical records, completing case report forms, data collection, and data entry. The CRC is required to be experienced in research with “hard-to-reach” and vulnerable populations, knowledge of resources for HCV and HIV prevention and education, drug abuse prevention and treatment, and street and community-based outreach methods. Phlebotomy certification is preferred, but not required. Having experience performing phlebotomy with people experiencing homelessness and people who inject drugs is preferable.

  

Required Qualifications:

* California Driver's License
* High Schol Diplima; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines

Preferred Qualifications:

* BA or BS in physical or biological sciences and one year of clinical research experience
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:

  + Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
  + Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
  + The Protection of Human Research Subjects
  + CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
  + Effective Cash Handling Procedures
  + Environmental Health and Safety Training
  + Fire Safety Training
  + Experience working with programs serving people experiencing homelessness and/or substance dependence

License/Certifications:

* California Driver's License

  + If required to drive, will use of a university vehicle be required? Yes

============================================

**TSMC North America**

**Account Manager / Technical Manager**

**Overview of Role**

TSMC North America is seeking an Account Manager / Technical Manager, based in San Jose, CA, to own the technical account relationship for one of TSMC’s key global customers serving diverse sectors, including data center, networking, broadband, and industrial markets. You will serve as a primary interface between the customer’s technical and procurement organizations, driving and managing both front-end silicon technology and backend packaging programs (2.5D/3D advanced packaging). The role demands fluency in semiconductor design, processes, and advanced packaging, strong commercial acumen, and the emotional intelligence to build synergy within an established, high-workload account team while operating independently and keeping tight alignment with TSMC headquarters. You will report to the Account Management team leader and partner with senior customer and TSMC stakeholders to strengthen the partnership and deliver measurable value across cost, quality, and time-to-market. TSMC currently operates a hybrid work schedule (4 days in office).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the account relationship for the assigned strategic customer, serving as the primary TSMC technical and commercial interface and sustaining executive-level alignment.
* Manage the customer’s selected front-end silicon and advanced packaging programs — 2.5D/3D packaging — from planning through production ramp. Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding customer’s product roadmaps and positioning the appropriate TSMC technologies.
* Translate customer product requirements into actionable programs with R&D, Planning, Field Technical Support (FTS), Business Development, Operations, and Finance, and coordinate closely with TSMC headquarters in Taiwan.
* Anticipate and address customer challenges, balancing TSMC’s objectives with the customer’s product and operational priorities.

* Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and conflict‑management skills.

* Prior TSMC or foundry account management / customer service experience supporting North America accounts.

TSMC pioneered the pure-play foundry business model when it was founded in 1987 and has been the world’s leading dedicated semiconductor foundry ever since. With global operations spanning Asia, Europe, and North America, TSMC serves as a committed corporate citizen around the world.

In North America, TSMC has a strong sales and service organization that works with customers by helping them achieve silicon success with cutting-edge technologies and manufacturing excellence. The Company has continued to accelerate its R&D investment and staffing in recent years and is expanding its manufacturing footprint to support customer innovation with 3D IC technologies and optimal manufacturing capacity.

We are seeking a highly driven, entrepreneurial, and results-oriented National Account Manager to lead and grow our Biscoff business at Target. This individual will own the Target business, including strategy, revenue growth, profitability, operational execution, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Target's systems, processes, and ways of working and is equally comfortable building long-term strategic growth plans as they are rolling up their sleeves to resolve deductions, manage Vendor Income agreements, troubleshoot inventory issues, or navigate item setup challenges. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, financial acumen, customer leadership, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will serve as the internal expert on all things Target and be accountable for delivering sustainable, profitable growth.

* Develop and execute the overall Target account strategy to deliver revenue, share, distribution, and profit objectives.
* Own annual business plans, customer growth strategies, assortment recommendations, promotional plans, and innovation launches.
* Lead Joint Business Planning initiatives and identify opportunities to expand the business within Target stores and digital channels.
* Build and maintain strong relationships across Target buying, planning, inventory, and merchandising teams.

* Demonstrated ability to work independently, while thriving in a nimble, entrepreneurial environment.

* Achieving sales goals and objectives in assigned territory/customers as derived by business strategies and marketing plans to drive profitable growth.

* A key component of the role will include a good awareness of competitive activities and a plan to effectively compete with the competition.

* Technical degree or Business degree required, additional MBA preferred.
* Knowledge in semiconductor manufacture, semiconductor customer, and associated Wet Etch Cleans, post-CMP cleans, or Slurry processes and related consumables.
* 3+ years of relative semiconductor industry experience required
* Proficient in planning/writing business case on how to proceed with a defined strategy.

jobs.description:
Diodes Incorporated is seeking a Strategic Account Sales Manager responsible for new business development, revenue growth, and strategic account management within a select group of major accounts. The successful candidate will support customers in identifying products, solutions, and services that best meet their needs while driving demand creation, design wins, and long-term growth opportunities. This position serves as the primary interface between the customer and Diodes' Business Units (BUs), Field Applications Engineers (FAEs), Marketing, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and Executive Leadership teams.

**Principle Duties and Responsibility:**

* Build and manage Account Plans for each assigned account and territory, keeping the extended team of stakeholders informed, engaged, and aligned to achieve growth objectives.
* Develop, communicate, and execute customer-specific account strategies based on compelling value propositions that drive new business opportunities and revenue growth.
* Own the design, deployment, and execution of winning account strategies to identify and capture every viable project, design opportunity, and revenue stream within assigned accounts.
* Drive demand creation activities by identifying customer roadmaps, projects, applications, and emerging technologies, aligning Diodes' product portfolio with customer requirements.
* Lead design-in and design-win activities across all Business Units to secure production business and increase market share.
* Develop and maintain an extensive knowledge base of assigned accounts, including business structure, technology roadmaps, key stakeholders, competitive landscape, purchasing processes, organizational dynamics, and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate closely with Business Unit Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, and FAEs to position products, develop technical solutions, and successfully close new design opportunities.
* Coordinate customer visits, technical reviews, executive meetings, and strategic planning sessions to strengthen customer relationships and uncover growth opportunities.
* Act as the primary escalation point for competitive, technical, quality, qualification, delivery, and commercial issues.
* Maintain accurate sales funnels, forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and account plans, providing visibility to Business Units and management on future revenue opportunities.
* Track and drive design wins from concept through production, ensuring alignment between customer requirements and internal execution.
* Communicate customer roadmaps, market trends, competitive intelligence, and emerging opportunities to Business Units to influence product development priorities and go-to-market strategies.
* Coordinate globally across sales organizations, Business Units, engineering teams, supply chain, and operations to facilitate alignment and strategic account execution.
* Conduct face-to-face customer management meetings as necessary to provide support, address issues, communicate updates, and build executive-level relationships.
* Negotiate and facilitate business matters including pricing, contracts, supply commitments, delivery schedules, and commercial agreements.
* Lead cross-functional teams consisting of Sales, FAEs, Product Marketing, Business Units, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Global Operations to achieve account objectives and revenue targets.
* Operate effectively within a highly matrixed global organization while driving accountability and execution across multiple functional groups.
* Respect and comply with all Diodes personnel, sales, proposal, and contract policies, while operating within company travel and expense guidelines.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* 5+ years of sales experience in the semiconductor industry with strategic account management, key account management, and/or territory management responsibilities.
* Proven success managing large strategic customers and complex sales opportunities within OEM, Cloud, AI, Industrial, Consumer, Communications, Networking, Computing, or Automotive markets.
* Preferred BSEE or BS degree with relevant semiconductor, electronics, or technology industry experience.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand customer architectures, product requirements, design challenges, and competitive solutions.
* Demonstrated experience driving demand creation, design-in, and design-win activities resulting in measurable revenue growth.
* Thorough understanding of semiconductor market dynamics, customer buying behaviors, competitive positioning, and industry trends.
* Proven ability to influence and coordinate global cross-functional resources to remove barriers and achieve customer and revenue objectives.
* Strong forecasting, pipeline management, account planning, and opportunity management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills with customers at engineering, procurement, management, and executive levels.
* Proven ability to build trust-based relationships and influence decision-makers throughout customer organizations.
* Ability to identify customer roadmaps and translate future technology requirements into actionable business opportunities for Diodes.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, responsiveness, follow-up discipline, and commitment to execution.
* Proven history of exceeding quota, achieving revenue targets, and delivering measurable business results in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Ability to effectively assess business opportunities, understand customer motivations, and develop winning sales strategies.
* Experience working successfully within a highly matrixed, multinational organization.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM-based opportunity management systems.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**About HappyRobot**
--------------------

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. As an SDR, you will play a key role in driving our company’s growth by generating and qualifying new business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, research, and engage potential clients through outbound prospecting.
* Manage and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects in the CRM.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for outreach, meetings, and opportunities generated.

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role (preferably in tech).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and a team player.
* Founder Mindset - You're here for a reason and ready to take risks for something unknown.
* Prior experience in SaaS or a tech startup is a plus.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

**Our Operating Principles**
----------------------------

***Extreme Ownership***

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

***Craftsmanship***

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

***We are “majos”***  
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

***Urgency with Focus***  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***  
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

***First-Principles Thinking***  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. The ideal candidate will help expand the clinic’s presence in the community, develop referral partnerships, and contribute to patient growth through proactive outreach activities.

* Visit local businesses, employers, and medical offices to introduce urgent care services and develop referral partnerships.

For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. **Job Description**
-------------------

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility, and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on-street bicycle facilities (1,200+ lane-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit seeks to hire a Program Operations Coordinator to assist the Chief of Cycling & Micromobility with administrative and programmatic duties. The Program Operations Coordinator will be responsible for managing the Chief’s calendar and scheduling meetings with internal and external entities. The Program Operations Coordinator will report on the Chief’s schedule and support meeting preparation by developing agendas, coordinating materials, taking minutes, and ensuring participants’ attendance. Responsibilities also include preparing and maintaining reports on incoming and completed requests and initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timeliness; flagging emails requiring timely follow-up; and coordinating regular unit progress reports for DOT leadership.
  
  
The selected candidate will maintain organized filing systems to ensure proper recordkeeping and accessibility and support improvements to the Unit’s file management system. The selected candidate will collaborate with the Unit’s senior leadership team and staff across DOT to address complex issues or escalate matters as needed. The selected candidate will work closely with OLS’s Director of Administration on administrative duties and procurement activities that support the Chief and the Unit. Additional duties may include filing and maintaining employee documentation, such as sick leave records; compiling tasks and standards and performance evaluations; and coordinating staff grant sheets. The selected candidate will coordinate external partner contacts, potentially conduct field observations, support outreach events, and provide general project support for the Unit’s programs and initiatives. The selected candidate will manage all aspects of the distribution of NYC DOT’s Bike Map, including coordinating with bicycle retailers citywide, managing shipments, and maintaining inventory. The selected candidate will coordinate all correspondence and mail, ensuring the Chief of Cycling & Micromobility receives external correspondence and that responses are prepared accordingly. The candidate will also support the Cycling & Micromobility Unit’s customer service coordination by assisting with processing correspondence, distributing assignments to appropriate staff, tracking responses, and drafting responses to correspondence received through NYC DOT’s public-facing website, the Mayor’s Office, the 311 Call Center, social media posts, and hard-copy mail addressed to the Commissioner related to the Unit’s projects and initiatives.
  
  
This position may require work on weekends and evenings to participate in staffing events and workshops across the city. The ideal candidate is passionate about expanding the reach of cycling in New York City, is well organized, and has strong communication skills, writing, verbal, and people skills to effectively respond to a variety of inquiries in a professional and courteous manner in compliance with NYC DOT standards.
  
  
The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.

**Job Title**: **Tradeshow & Events Operations Coordinator**

**Location**: Hoboken, NJ

**Division:** Management

**Department:** Marketing

**About Us:**

Quantum Computing Inc. (QCi) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an innovative, integrated photonics company that provides accessible and affordable quantum machines to the world today. QCi products are designed to operate at room temperature and low power at an affordable cost. The Company’s portfolio of core technology and products offer unique capabilities in the areas of high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, cyber security as well as remote sensing applications.

**Scope of the Job:**

QCi is seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and hands-on **Tradeshow & Events Operations Coordinator** to help plan and execute the company’s tradeshows, conferences, exhibitions, customer events, and industry engagements.

This highly visible, travel-intensive position supports the full event lifecycle, including pre-event planning, exhibitor logistics, vendor coordination, shipping, booth setup, on-site operations, teardown, return shipping, and post-event reporting. The Coordinator will work closely with the Tradeshow & Events Specialist and partner with Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Engineering, and executive leadership to deliver professional, engaging, and well-organized event experiences.

The ideal candidate enjoys live-event environments, takes initiative, stays composed when plans change, and is comfortable jumping in wherever needed. This position is well suited for someone who combines strong project coordination skills with a practical, hands-on approach to event execution.

**What You’ll Do**

**Tradeshow and Event Operations**

* Support the planning and execution of tradeshows, conferences, exhibitions, customer events, and other industry engagements.
* Travel to event locations to provide hands-on support before, during, and after each event.
* Assist with booth setup and teardown, including displays, graphics, signage, furniture, technology, literature, and promotional materials.
* Confirm that event materials, equipment, technology, and services are delivered, organized, tested, and ready before an event opens.
* Maintain a clean, organized, fully stocked, and professional booth environment throughout each event.
* Manage packing, labeling, return shipping, and the safe storage of event materials following each event.
* Troubleshoot shipping, vendor, technology, and operational issues in real time.

**Event Planning and Logistics**

* Maintain event timelines, project plans, checklists, staffing schedules, registrations, exhibitor requirements, sponsorship deliverables, and key deadlines.
* Coordinate event services such as freight, drayage, electrical, internet, AV, furniture, catering, labor, and booth support.
* Assist with hotel and travel logistics for participating employees and executives, as needed.
* Prepare signage, marketing collateral, literature, promotional items, giveaways, and event supplies.
* Create and maintain packing lists, standardized event kits, run-of-show documents, and other event-planning materials.
* Participate in pre-event planning meetings, on-site briefings, and post-event debriefs.

**Vendor and Partner Coordination**

* Communicate with event organizers, venues, general contractors, freight and drayage providers, AV partners, printers, booth vendors, and promotional-item suppliers.
* Obtain and organize vendor quotes, orders, invoices, deadlines, and deliverables.
* Monitor vendor activities before and during events to ensure requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.
* Escalate potential risks and help resolve logistical or operational issues quickly and professionally.

**On-Site Event Support**

* Provide on-site support to Sales, Business Development, executives, engineers, customers, and partners.
* Coordinate booth coverage, staffing schedules, customer meetings, product demonstrations, presentations, receptions, and related activities.
* Welcome attendees and help create an engaging and professional QCi experience.
* Support lead capture and ensure attendee information is accurately recorded and routed for timely follow-up.
* Monitor booth traffic, inventory, supplies, technology, and overall presentation.
* Respond professionally to last-minute requests, shifting priorities, and changing event requirements.

**Event Inventory and Asset Management**

* Maintain accurate inventory of booth properties, displays, signage, literature, promotional items, technology, and event supplies.
* Coordinate replenishment, printing, and distribution of event materials.
* Ensure event assets are packed, labeled, stored, and prepared for future use.
* Identify missing, damaged, outdated, or low-stock materials and coordinate appropriate follow-up.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration and Reporting**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Engineering, and other teams to support event objectives.
* Assist with event-specific communications, collateral, presentations, and other marketing materials.
* Capture event photos and approved content for marketing purposes.
* Support tracking and reporting of event KPIs, including attendance, leads, meetings, engagement, opportunities, and expenses.
* Assist with post-event reporting, follow-up activities, ROI analysis, and recommendations to improve future events and attendee experiences.

**What We’re Looking For**

* One to three years of experience in tradeshow coordination, event operations, experiential marketing, corporate events, hospitality, marketing operations, or a related field.
* Experience supporting live events, conferences, exhibitions, corporate events, or tradeshows.
* Strong organizational, project coordination, and time-management skills.
* Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage several events, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.**
  
Our vision is to build a thriving entertainment ecosystem where stories and worlds are imagined, brought to life and experienced. We create for every age and audience, anchored by the strength of our content and experiences and the depth of our connection with fans. We are creator-first, audience-focused, tech-forward, globally scaled.
  
  
Here, you’ll work with talented teams that move fast, think boldly and collaborate with purpose to deliver results. We aim high, champion the best ideas and win together, earning the trust of our employees, creators, partners and audiences every day.

  

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

  

**Overview:**
-------------

As part of the Programmatic sales team, the Programmatic Account Manager plays an important role in growing our programmatic advertising revenue. Programmatic Account Managers are in charge of collaborating with the Programmatic and Direct AEs to manage existing business and generate new programmatic revenue from agencies and marketers, with a consultative and technical advertising approach.

This role requires deep knowledge and comprehension of programmatic advertising and the supporting AdTech ecosystem of DSPs and SSPs, and a strategic and analytical approach to troubleshooting, data analytics and client relations.

The Programmatic Account Management team is a central team within the Sales organization tasked with spearheading programmatic revenue and embracing the innovation and ad technology that our programmatic team brings to the marketplace. The Programmatic sales team partners with the convergent sales team and executives working with direct clients, agencies, and third-party partners (e. g. SSPs, DSPs, ATDs, etc).

Located in New York, the Programmatic Account Manager supports our programmatic sales team with planning, executing and monitoring the programmatic ad campaigns. This role works closely with Programmatic clients, the Programmatic and Direct Sales teams and the Programmatic Partnerships team to ensure impeccable campaign planning and execution. This includes diligent campaign management across all steps of the sales process (Pre-sales, Campaign Launch, Post Delivery) while working closely with internal stakeholders, clients and partners to maximize the effectiveness and revenue potential of their programmatic deals and campaigns.

**Responsibilities include but not limited to:**
------------------------------------------------

* Support the education and evangelization of our programmatic strategy, best practices, and offerings both internally and externally. Serving as a key programmatic subject matter expert, evangelist and sales resource to drive programmatic revenue via PMPs and PG.
* Develop a solid awareness of our Ad Tech stack, integrated partners and the general programmatic ecosystem
* Become power user of key third-party systems such as Salesforce, Operative and SSP user portals (such as FreeWheel, Magnite and PubMatic) which are utilized for deal set up, management, troubleshooting and forecasting.
* Serve as the PMP Deal Manager and Client Service Lead for your assigned Hold Co and Accounts with:
* **Pre Campaign Launch/Deal Creation** - Lead PMP Deal Set up and Troubleshooting including Creative QA process, Forecasting support
* **Deal Launch** - Forward-thinking Deal Monitoring, Continued Troubleshooting to ensure campaigns start on time and without any issues
* **Deal Monitoring** - Observant PMP campaign monitoring to maximize spend - including PMP pacing spend/deal health, optimizations/recommendations, Internal and External PMP Reporting from Salesforce/Freewheel, continued forecasting support
* **Client Servicing** - Forward-thinking involvement with your Programmatic clients through regular check ins to provide regular PMP reports and insights related to deal health while Instilling PMP Best Practices with buyers
* **Sales Prospecting** - Support your assigned Programmatic Account Executives proactive prospecting providing spend reports through indirect opportunities, bid CPM optimization, week over week top spenders across Direct & Indirect businesses
* Collaborate with the Direct Sales team with Programmatic Guaranteed Deal Management to ensure campaign delivery and troubleshooting.

**Basic Qualifications:**
-------------------------

* A BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience
* 2+ years proven advertising sales experience in the programmatic space

**Additional Qualifications:**

jobs.title: Cloud Technical Account Manager, ES - NAMER - US-SMB
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes gain the best value and service from AWS? AWS Enterprise Support Technical Account Managers (TAM) support our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, Deployment, Security and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.
  
  
The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.
  
  
More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services including EC2, S3, DynamoDB & RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT and many more.
  
  
Your technical acumen and customer-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade-offs, support and risk management.
  
  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.
  
  
The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  
  
The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation come join us!  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer's environment for troubleshooting customer support issues rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution.

  
A day in the life  
You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices and proactively keep your customers' AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient.  
  
About the team  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead
* Understanding of the AWS Well-Architected Framework pillars and ability to properly apply them to existing or new customer architecture, implementations, and/or solutions
* Experience applying technical or operational expertise to identify, balance trade-offs, and solve difficult challenges

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodati

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
**About HappyRobot**
--------------------

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly motivated **Sales Development Representative (SDR)** to join our growing team. As an SDR, you will play a key role in driving our company’s growth by generating and qualifying new business opportunities.

**What You’ll Do**

* Identify, research, and engage potential clients through outbound prospecting.
* Manage and maintain an organized pipeline of prospects in the CRM.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies.
* Conduct market research to identify new business opportunities.
* Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly KPIs for outreach, meetings, and opportunities generated.

**Must have**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, or a related role (preferably in tech).
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and a team player.
* Founder Mindset - You're here for a reason and ready to take risks for something unknown.
* Prior experience in SaaS or a tech startup is a plus.

**Why join us?**
----------------

* Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
* Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
* Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
* Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
* Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

**Our Operating Principles**
----------------------------

***Extreme Ownership***

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

***Craftsmanship***

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

***We are “majos”***  
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

***Urgency with Focus***  
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

***Talent Density and Meritocracy***  
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

***First-Principles Thinking***  
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

jobs.title: Salesforce Data & Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**position background**

**The 4As is the voice of the agency community across America. The global ad industry is**

**set to pass $1 Trillion in spend this year. The US is set to have $491 billion of that spend.**

**And represent 20% of US GDP. So, to be the voice of the industry is a real and unique**

**honor. The things we do, stand for, and advocate for shape the direction of our industry.**

**Over a 108-year history the 4As has gone from reacting to member organization needs**

**and key industry topics to the organization today which must set agendas, continually**

**represent the broad agency community, and amplify its constituents’ voice in a more**

**complex ecosystem of brands, platforms, creators, technology solutions and clients.**

  

**position overview**

The Salesforce Data & Operations Coordinator supports the day-to-day administration and data management functions of the 4As Salesforce/Nimble AMS environment. This is an entry-level technical role focused on data quality, record maintenance, reporting, and operational support — serving as a key resource for keeping member data accurate, current, and actionable across the organization.

  

Working closely with the Nimble Database Manager and cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will spend the majority of their time directly in Salesforce: processing bulk data updates, building and maintaining reports, supporting data import/export workflows, and documenting operational procedures. This role is well-suited to someone who is detail-driven, technically curious, and eager to grow their Salesforce expertise in a mission-driven association environment.

**Qualities essential to thrive in this role:**

* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Comfort working in systems and databases day-to-day
* Organized, methodical approach to repetitive and process-driven tasks
* Clear written and verbal communicator
* Collaborative and proactive — comfortable asking questions and flagging issues
* Eagerness to learn Salesforce and grow technical skills over time

  

**position responsibilities**

**Core responsibilities and tasks include:**

**Data Management & Quality**

* Perform bulk data imports, exports, and updates using Data Loader or similar tools
* Execute manual record updates and data corrections within Salesforce/Nimble AMS
* Identify and resolve duplicate records; support ongoing deduplication efforts
* Support Data Health projects, including data scrubbing and validation
* Monitor data integrity and flag inconsistencies to the Nimble Database Manager

  

**Reporting & Analysis**

* Build and maintain standard reports and dashboards within Salesforce
* Pull and format data for staff requests, leadership reviews, and membership communications
* Assist with tracking member rosters, engagement data, and participation records

**Process Documentation & Support**

* Create and maintain SOPs and step-by-step documentation for recurring data processes
* Document workflow configurations, field mappings, and data standards for team reference
* Assist in the development of training materials for staff Salesforce users
* Provide basic end-user support and troubleshooting for staff questions about Salesforce

**Administration & Coordination**

* Support configuration of custom fields and objects under the direction of the Nimble Database Manager
* Assist with testing and QA for system updates, new features, and workflow changes
* Coordinate with Business Units on data requests and operational needs
* Respond to member support requests related to data and Salesforce access, and assist with other duties as needed to support team and organizational goals.

  

**position requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field
* Foundational knowledge of Salesforce; hands-on experience (including coursework, internships, or Trailhead) strongly preferred
* Salesforce Administrator certification a plus — not required; support for certification provided
* Comfort working with data: importing, exporting, cleaning, and organizing large record sets
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for data preparation and review
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks with accuracy
* Familiarity with trade associations, membership organizations, or nonprofit environments is a plus

jobs.description:
**About Teneo**

Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions and organizations.

Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance and ESG.

The firm has more than 1,800 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.

**The Role**

The People Operations Coordinator will join the US People Team and support employees throughout the employee lifecycle. This person will help manage onboarding and offboarding, maintain accurate employee data in Workday, respond to day-to-day People questions, and coordinate learning programs. This role is well suited for someone who is organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

This is a temporary assignment with the potential to convert to a full-time role. Any conversion will depend on performance and business needs.

**Responsibilities**

People Operations and Employee Lifecycle

* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding, including Workday tasks, employment agreements, background checks, I-9 verification, orientation, and required documentation.

* Serve as a point of contact for candidates, new joiners, employees, and managers, responding to routine People questions and requests and ensuring timely follow-through.

* Support contractor agreements, onboarding, Workday records, and offboarding.

* Process employee changes and maintain accurate and complete records in Workday.

* Support employment verifications and other routine employee matters.

Workday and Team Support

* Help employees and managers navigate Workday processes, troubleshoot issues, and keep requests moving.

* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, review data quality, and partner with the HRIS team to improve reporting.

* Support annual People processes, including goal setting, performance, promotion, and compensation reviews.

* Update People policies, process guides, and employee communications, while identifying practical ways to improve the employee experience.

* Support People Team initiatives such as internships, employee events, benefits enrollment, and employee resource group activity.

Learning and Development

* Coordinate learning programs for employees at different career stages.

* Manage registration, calendar invitations, attendance, materials, participant communications, and follow-up.

* Maintain learning records, trackers, resources, and recordings across SharePoint and other platforms.

* Coordinate with internal facilitators, external vendors, and other stakeholders.

* Administer participant surveys and prepare clear summaries of participation, completion, and feedback data.

**Qualifications**

* At least two years of relevant experience in Human Resources, People Operations, Learning and Development, or a related role. Professional services experience is helpful.

* Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.

* A practical, service-oriented approach, with clear written and verbal communication skills.

* Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential employee information.

* Experience using Workday is strongly preferred.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with an interest in using AI and new tools responsibly.

* Bachelor’s degree required.

* Ability to work from the New York office at least three days per week, including Mondays.

  

**Assignment and compensation**

This position will begin as a temporary assignment and may convert to a full-time role based on performance and business needs. The position is based in New York City and follows Teneo’s hybrid work policy.

**Hourly pay range**

$40-45 per hour. The final rate will depend on the candidate’s experience, skills and qualifications. Benefits, if any, will depend on the terms of the temporary assignment and whether the individual is hired directly by Teneo or through a staffing partner.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

Teneo is an equal opportunity employer and promotes a diverse and inclusive workplace. Teneo considers all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or sexual orientation or any other status protected by applicable law.

**Flexible Work Policy:**

Teneo believes in in-person collaboration when possible and if you are assigned to the San Francisco office, the company's expectation is for employees to work from the office location a minimum of three days a week.Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.

**Position Summary**

Momentive Software is seeking a motivated and curious **Business Development Representative (BDR)** to join our Atlanta team. This role is designed for **recent college graduates** or individuals **new to the professional workforce** who are excited to learn the foundations of sales, grow quickly, and make a meaningful impact.
