**B2B Inside Sales Representative, Edible Arrangements**

**Who are we and what do we do?**

Edible Brands® was launched in 2022 to bring together powerful, purpose-led brands under one unified purpose: to enrich everyday life through celebration, nourishment, and wellness. Today, Edible Brands powers bold and growing concepts across 600+ locations worldwide.

Our portfolio spans Edible Arrangements®, the iconic gifting brand; Rōti®, a Mediterranean-inspired fast-casual restaurant; and BerryDirect®, our robust supply chain infrastructure. Together, these brands are fueled by *The Edible Brands Way*—a set of employee-driven values that keep us committed, collaborative, adaptable, results-driven, and always ready to celebrate.

**The Big Picture:**

As the Inside Sales Representative on Edible Arrangements Corporate Gifting Sales team, you’ll play a key role in helping to launch and grow our new business gifting program. Reporting directly to the Director of Corporate Gifting, you’ll be responsible for building strong relationships with business clients, understanding their gifting needs, and recommending the right Edible solutions when gifting employees, clients, and partners. You’ll use data-driven outreach, a service-first mindset, and a passion for helping others to drive sales, create loyal customers, and establish the foundation for a scalable, high-impact B2B sales channel.

**Location:** This position will work onsite out of our Corporate Office in Sandy Springs, GA Monday – Friday, with limited travel when necessary.

**What that looks like day to day:**

* Prospect and qualify new business customers through outbound calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn engagement.
* Use sales data and client insights to identify trends, think critically about new business opportunities, and creatively craft new outreach approaches or seasonal campaigns.
* Present tailored sales proposals for client gifting needs such as employee appreciation, holiday gifting, client thank-yous, and event-based campaigns.
* Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact to closing the deal, including follow-up, negotiation, and coordination with fulfillment teams.
* Develop and maintain a rolling sales pipeline, consistently working to move prospects through the funnel and increase conversion rates.
* Meet and exceed monthly quotas for outreach activity, closed revenue, and repeat business from B2B customers.
* Track all interactions and opportunities with high attention to detail and accurate forecasting.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Operations and the Innovation teams to ensure seamless delivery and exceptional client experiences.
* Identify opportunities for recurring programs and annual gifting campaigns, converting one-time buyers into repeat corporate clients.
* Represent the Edible Arrangements voice and values, delivering an experience that celebrates both our clients and their gift recipients.

**What you bring:**

* 1–3 years of B2B inside sales experience, ideally in corporate gifting, CPG, or a high-activity outbound sales environment.
* Proven success managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing deals remotely via phone, email, and virtual meetings.
* Hands-on experience tracking pipeline, forecasting, and performance metrics.
* Comfort navigating ambiguity — experience working in a startup, new business unit, or early-stage sales program with evolving processes highly preferred
* Exposure to building or refining sales processes, feedback loops, or playbooks to help shape a new sales operation from the ground up.

**How you work:**

* Self-starter mindset – thrives in an environment with limited structure and takes initiative without waiting to be told what to do.
* Curiosity and creativity – naturally seeks out new business opportunities, thinks outside the box, and tailors solutions to customer needs.
* Strong communication skills – able to build trust quickly over the phone and in writing, and represent the Edible professionally.
* Agility and adaptability – able to pivot when needed, iterate quickly on messaging, and stay focused as the program evolves.
* Team-oriented but independent – enjoys collaborating cross-functionally, while still owning personal targets and daily workflow.

**What We Offer:**

* Strong team-oriented environment, emphasizing cross-functional partnerships
* The stability and resources of an industry-leading company successfully operating for 25 years, with the agility and innovation of a startup, allowing you to make a significant impact and shape our future.
* Growth & Development – Each team member has a visible and immediate impact on the business, offering abundant opportunities for personal and professional growth as we scale in size and sophistication
* Healthcare plans that include health/dental/vision insurance, 401K Plan, company-paid life insurance and short-term disability, flexible spending account options and more
* Paid time off, including sick days & holidays to support work-life balance

*We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer. Applicants for employment are considered without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, and disability, or veteran status.*

Aerovy is the operating layer for hardware OEMs. We take the signals coming off equipment in mobility, industrial, material handling, and construction, and normalize them into one model for assets, components, health, and events that holds across brands and model years.

With Aerovy, OEMs:

* **Launch an AI ecosystem for their hardware:** branded apps a manufacturer puts in front of its own customers, from the app that comes with the machine to connected services and subscription tiers
* **Elevate aftermarket service:** the machine reports a fault, it's diagnosed, the right technician is dispatched with the right part, and the job is closed out and reported. First-time fix rates go up; time to acknowledgement and time to response come down
* **Cut warranty cost and service spend:** predictive failure detection, automated triage, and AI-driven root-cause across their install base

We're a fast-paced startup building the digital infrastructure for the next generation of intelligent hardware. Founded in 2023 as a spinoff of research from Purdue University, we've grown from 5 full-time workers at the end of 2025 to 13 today, with ARR up 4x+ over the same period. We're backed by institutional VCs from Mudita Venture Partners, M25, Quorum Capital Partners, Knoll Ventures, and Purdue Ventures, and angels from Google, Tesla, Intel, Siemens +more.

**The role**
============

As the first Business Development Representative at Aerovy, you’ll report directly to the CEO. The job has two halves. The first is outbound: working the 120-account named list to find the right person at the right OEM and get them into a qualified first meeting. The second is pipeline support: the CEO is personally carrying live enterprise deals, and you make sure none of them stall. Follow-ups go out on time, next steps get booked, HubSpot reflects reality, and conference meetings are on the calendar before we land.

Most BDR seats stop at the meeting. This one doesn’t. You stay on a deal through close. We’re looking for someone who treats a VP of Aftermarket’s calendar as a puzzle to solve, writes a clean email, and would rather own a number than a task list.

**Responsibilities**
====================

* Run outbound against the named-account list: research the account, identify the aftermarket and digital stakeholders, build sequences in Apollo, and book qualified meetings.
* Qualify to our standard before handoff: a champion, a next meeting on the calendar, and a number the buyer put on the problem.
* Own follow-through on the CEO’s direct pipeline: send recaps, chase open items, schedule the next step, and keep every deal moving between meetings.
* Keep HubSpot current: contacts, deal stages, Sourced by and Qualified properties, and the notes a teammate would need to pick up the deal cold.
* Pre-book meetings for trade shows and conferences, build the onsite schedule, and run post-show follow-up within the week.
* Put sales automation and AI to work on account research, list building, and personalization so one person can cover a list this size.
* Prep the CEO for calls: who’s in the room, what they said last time, what we need out of the meeting.
* Feed what you hear in outbound back to marketing: which messages land, which objections repeat, which titles reply.
* Write down what works so the next BDR starts from your process.

**Job Requirements**

* 1 to 3 years in a BDR, SDR, or sales support role selling B2B software, or a track record of persistent, organized outreach from another field.
* Written communication that’s clear and short; you can draft a cold email a VP would actually read.
* Comfort on the phone and in person, including walking a trade show floor and opening conversations cold.
* Organized to a fault: you keep a CRM clean without being asked and nothing falls through between meetings.
* Fluency with HubSpot, Apollo, or similar prospecting and CRM tools, and curiosity about using AI to do more of the work.
* Coachable and low ego: you’ll be running someone else’s playbook before you improve it.
* Based in Atlanta or able to be in the office regularly, with travel to conferences and customer sites.

**Nice to Haves**

* Exposure to manufacturing, industrial equipment, fleet, or aftermarket and field service
* You’ve supported an enterprise deal from first meeting through signature and can describe what you did to keep it moving
* Experience planning or working trade shows

**Additional Notes**

* This role is based in Atlanta, with travel to conferences and customer sites.

Compensation Range: $55K - $80K

**JOB DESCRIPTION -**

Chicago Public Schools (CPS) is one of the largest school districts in the United States, serving over 330,000 students in 600+ schools and employing nearly 36,000 people, most of them teachers. Six core values are embedded within these commitments – student-centered, whole child, equity, academic excellence, community partnership, and continuous learning.

District-run CPS schools are organized into 18 networks, which provide administrative support, strategic direction, and leadership development to the schools within each network. This network support model is designed to support the unique needs of CPS elementary and high schools and their school leaders that focuses exclusively on their needs. Network 1 focuses on elementary schools in the northern geographic area of Chicago.

* Maintain confidential and time-sensitive materials.

**Experience Required:**

* Minimum of five (5) years of administrative support experience
* Minimum of three (3) years of work experience supporting senior-level executives preferred
* Minimum three (3) years as a School Clerk or Network support staff preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written and interpersonal), with the ability to interact positively and professionally at all times with parents, students, external partners, schools, and CPS Departments
* Working knowledge or the ability to learn CPS applications: KRONOS, Verify, ORACLE, Dashboard and Google Drive application
* Ability to successfully manage work in a fast-paced professional environment, and operate with a sense of urgency while maintaining a customer focus
* Ability to manage multiple projects and simultaneous deadlines

10. Initiate, track and close work orders utilizing systems for property.

Professional appearance and the ability to resolve conflicts in a professional manner.
